raw_text: The session tested Gemini as an alternative instrument worker alongside a lean worker variant, with parity runs on the same Sutton pipeline steps. Plain Gemini calls worked. Grounded Gemini search failed on a Google billing quota error, but nothing currently routes to search, so this had no present cost impact. The user recalled an earlier "too many requests" rate-limiting problem with the same provider, and that history shaped how the Gemini worker was handled. The decision about how to divide work across providers was recorded as a "worker cost split" idea in the capture inbox.
